title: No Record Outside the Bible Names Abraham
author: QUILL
notes: Distance is straight-line. Camel anachronism is a claim by some scholars. Not-proven line in beat 10.

beats.text: Outside the Bible, no undisputed record names Abraham.
Yet his road is mapped, and the strangest clue is a camel.
Ur of the Chaldeans: its ziggurat still stands in Iraq.
beats.say: Ur of the Kal-DEE-ans: its ZIG-oo-rat still stands in Iraq.

beats.text: Terah leads the family north-west. Then Abram, seventy-five, hears: go.
beats.say: TEH-rah leads the family north-west. Then AY-bram, seventy-five, hears: go.

beats.text: Ur to Haran, in Turkey: about 900 kilometres as the crow flies.
beats.say: Ur to HAR-an, in Turkey: about nine hundred kilometres as the crow flies.

beats.text: God promises: To your offspring I will give this land.
beats.display: To your offspring I will give this land.

beats.text: He crosses to Shechem in Canaan and builds an altar.
beats.say: He crosses to SHEK-em in Canaan and builds an altar.

beats.text: But famine strikes, so he goes down to Egypt.
beats.label: FAMINE

beats.text: Genesis lists camels among Pharaoh's gifts. Some scholars say domesticated camels came later.
Not proven: Abraham himself. His historicity is debated.
Ur to Egypt: one family's road across the Fertile Crescent.
Outside the Bible, no undisputed record names Abraham. Real journey, or legend?
